c.tagline: The official hometown of Santa Claus and Finland's gateway to the Arctic Circle.

taxi.fareNote: Metered, with prices varying by operator. Ride-hailing (Uber/Bolt) is available but limited in Lapland — most locals book taxis by phone or via apps like Valopilkku and Menevä, and pre-booking is wise in winter.

emergency.note: 112 is Finland's single emergency number for police, fire, and ambulance; English is widely spoken by dispatchers.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_landmark.Santa Claus Village: Santa Claus Village Arctic Circle Rovaniemi

hood_desc: The compact, walkable heart of Rovaniemi around Lordi Square and Koskikatu, rebuilt to Alvar Aalto's reindeer-antler street plan after WWII, with the Arktikum museum, Korundi art hall, restaurants, and shops; best for first-timers who want everything within reach and easy bus links to the airport and Santa Claus Village.

The famous Arctic Circle theme village 8 km north, home to Santa Claus's Office, the main post office, husky and reindeer rides, glass-igloo resorts, and Christmas attractions; suits families and first-timers who want to wake up on the Arctic Circle.

A forested hill and year-round outdoor-sports area across the Kemijoki river, with ski and toboggan slopes, hiking and fat-bike trails, SantaPark, and lower light pollution for the northern lights; suits nature lovers and aurora hunters.

The area around the railway station and river just south of the center, quieter and residential but still walking distance to downtown; convenient for arrivals on the overnight Santa Claus Express from Helsinki.

A riverside residential district on the eastern bank near Santa Claus Village, close to wilderness and aurora resorts along the Kemijoki; good for a calm base with easy access to husky farms and reindeer safaris.

water.note: Finnish tap water is among the cleanest in the world.

transit.pay: Pay by contactless card or cash on board, or buy tickets via the Linkkari app; the Airport Santa Express is a separate service (about €7 one way) linking the train station, city center, airport, and Santa Claus Village.
transit.hours: Local buses run roughly 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM with limited weekend service; the Airport Santa Express runs to match flight and attraction times.
transit.note: Rovaniemi has no tram or metro; a small city bus network (Linkkari) plus the Airport Santa Express connect the center, airport, and Santa Claus Village, and many visitors rely on taxis, rental cars, or tour transfers.

train: Rovaniemi Railway Station (VR day trains and the overnight Santa Claus Express car-carrier to/from Helsinki)
bus: Rovaniemi Bus Station (Matkahuolto long-distance coaches across Lapland and south to the rest of Finland)

transit.m: Airport Santa Express bus to the city center and Santa Claus Village (~20 min)
Taxi to the city center (10-15 min)

tip.r: Not expected; service is included in prices. Rounding up or leaving a small amount for excellent service is appreciated but never required.
